title: Dapp Ideas
tagline: Mint your projects as NFTs to gain some decentralised funding
description: The idea was to have a way for people to celebrate asking questions and building open source projects by minting them as NFTs in an effort to incentivise the same. Left incomplete due to webpack issues. The project can further be extended to a token gated community of builders and researchers who celebrate finding answers and putting those answers to use!
how_its_made: The project was initiated with Create React App. It uses chakra-ui for flexible components and for rapid development. Additionally, it uses Dappcore and The Ether Project for web3 handling, specifically the `useEthers` hook from Dappcore. There is also ENS integration using the Davatar library for ENS avatars to show up. Finally, the minting was to happen on Zora's protocol but due to webpack differences (v4 vs v5), the project broke and is left incomplete.
